simple.summary: צֶבַע (tsebaʻ) means a dye First listed occurrence: Judg 5 30.

definitions.full: H6648. tseba צֶ֫בַע noun [masculine] dye, dyed stuff ; — construct צ ׳רִקְמָתַיִם Judg 5:30 (perhaps strike out ׳צ , compare GFM); plural צְבָעִים שְׁלַל booty of dyed stuffs 5:30 ; 5:30 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to dip (into coloring fluid);
